_note: Tool list and URLs taken from the warminboxes.com page export supplied 2026-09-16. supportsDomainParam is null where it has not been confirmed with the WI dev team.

tools.name: BIMI Checker
tools.short: Validate your brand logo record, SVG, VMC and the DMARC enforcement Gmail requires.

tools.name: Blacklist Checker
tools.short: Check if your domain or IP is listed on 20+ major email blacklists in seconds.
tools.ifFails: Delisting takes days and often does not stick. A prewarmed .com ships today.

tools.name: Bounce Analyzer
tools.short: Paste bounce messages, get the root cause in plain English plus a pause-or-continue verdict.
tools.ifFails: A reputation block disguised as a soft bounce means stop sending now.

tools.name: CNAME Checker
tools.short: Follow the full CNAME chain and catch the mistakes that break a cold email tracking domain.
tools.ifFails: A shared tracking host pools reputation with every other sender on it.

tools.name: CSV List Cleaner
tools.short: Dedupe and scrub lead lists entirely in your browser, nothing gets uploaded.

tools.name: CSV Combiner
tools.short: Merge multiple lead lists into one, matching headers and deduping emails.

tools.name: Deliverability Checker
tools.short: Grade your domain A to F across SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX, blacklists and domain age.
tools.ifFails: Under 80% placement? Adding volume to a damaged domain makes it worse.

tools.name: DKIM Checker
tools.short: Auto-scan 26 common selectors and validate your DKIM signing key strength.
tools.useWhen: You do not know which selector is live
tools.ifFails: Published but not signing is the most common silent failure.

tools.name: DMARC Checker
tools.short: Validate and analyse your DMARC record, policy, tags and verdicts explained.
tools.useWhen: Before moving policy to quarantine or reject
tools.ifFails: Every prewarmed domain ships with DMARC already set.

tools.name: DNS Checker
tools.short: Query MX, TXT, CNAME, A and all other DNS record types for any domain.
tools.ifFails: MX wrong means replies vanish. Fix it or replace the domain.

tools.name: Domain Expiry Checker
tools.short: Monitor domain expiration dates and catch renewals before they lapse.
tools.useWhen: You run a fleet and renewals are manual
tools.ifFails: An expired sending domain kills delivery and replies at once.

tools.name: Email Verifier
tools.short: SMTP-level mailbox verification with catch-all detection.
tools.useWhen: Before a list touches a domain

tools.name: ESP Segmentation & Mailbox Calculator
tools.short: Split your list by Google, Microsoft and gateway inboxes, then get told how many mailboxes to buy.
tools.useWhen: You do not know your recipient mix
tools.ifFails: A Microsoft-heavy list wants Microsoft infrastructure.

tools.name: Google Domain Checker
tools.short: See if a domain is already tied to a Google Workspace account or clear for fresh inboxes.
tools.useWhen: Account setup failed on a domain
tools.ifFails: Already linked to another Microsoft account. Use a clean prewarmed domain instead.

tools.name: Header Analyzer
tools.short: Paste raw headers: SPF, DKIM, DMARC, alignment and hops explained in plain English.
tools.useWhen: You need to know why one message failed
tools.ifFails: Authentication failing at the receiver is an infrastructure problem.

tools.name: Domain & Inbox Planner
tools.short: Target volume in, exact domains and inboxes needed out, with a safe ramp-up plan.
tools.useWhen: Sizing a new campaign or client

tools.name: Inbox Previewer
tools.short: See your sender, subject and snippet exactly as Gmail and Outlook render them.

tools.name: Inbox Rotation Planner
tools.short: Split your fleet into rotating batches with a schedule, no burned inboxes.
tools.useWhen: Running more inboxes than one pod

tools.name: MTA-STS Checker
tools.short: Validate your _mta-sts record and policy file: enforce mode, MX patterns and TLS-RPT.

tools.name: Nameserver Checker
tools.short: One domain or a whole CSV: get NS records and the DNS provider behind every domain.
tools.ifFails: Domains on a vendor nameserver are theirs, not yours.

tools.name: Pre-Send Checker
tools.short: Catch broken merge tags, dupes and spintax errors, and forecast send volume.
tools.useWhen: Right before a sequence goes live

tools.name: Record Generator
tools.short: Build correct SPF, DKIM and DMARC records, with ready-made settings for Google, Microsoft and the big sending tools.
tools.useWhen: Standing up a new sending domain
tools.ifFails: Copied records carry includes you do not use. Generate them.

tools.name: Outlook SCL Analyzer
tools.short: Paste Outlook headers and find out exactly why the message went to Junk.
tools.ifFails: Microsoft-heavy list? Send from Microsoft infrastructure.

tools.name: Sequencer CSV Converter
tools.short: Convert lead CSVs between Instantly, Smartlead and Email Bison formats.

tools.name: Spam Checker
tools.short: Scan your subject and body for 200+ weighted spam triggers and formatting red flags.

tools.name: SPF Checker & Generator
tools.short: Look up existing SPF records or build a new one, with recursive lookup counting.
tools.useWhen: Setting up or auditing a domain
tools.ifFails: Over ten lookups is a PermError, and a PermError is a failure.

tools.name: Spintax & Liquid Tester
tools.short: Preview every spintax variation and personalization variable before sending.

tools.name: Suppression Checker
tools.short: Check any list against customers, unsubscribes and previously contacted companies.

tools.name: SURBL & Spamhaus DBL Checker
tools.short: Bulk-check domains against the SURBL and Spamhaus DBL URI blacklists.
tools.useWhen: Sending domain is clean but mail still filters
tools.ifFails: Your tracking domain or links are listed, not your sender.

tools.name: Unsubscribe Generator
tools.short: CAN-SPAM and GDPR compliant opt-out footers in plain text and HTML.

tools.name: Waterfall Calculator
tools.short: Find the cheapest verifier order and your true cost per usable email.

tools.name: Cold Email Stack Calculator
tools.short: Target sends a day in, inboxes, domains and monthly cost out.
tools.useWhen: Sizing a campaign or a client

tools.name: Warmup Tax Calculator
tools.short: What running your own 51-day cycle costs, per year.
tools.useWhen: Deciding whether to warm your own
